## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run typecheck` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the changed code
- [ ] Product text (code, tool descriptions, anything an agent reads) is in English
- [ ] If it adds a migration, the migration is applied to production right before merging (the Deploy workflow deploys on merge)
- [ ] I have signed the [CLA](../CLA.md) (the bot asks on your first pull request)
